name: Chococo
usp: British artisan chocolatier handcrafting single-origin chocolates from direct-trade partnerships with farmers in Colombia and Ecuador, with a cafe-style Chocolate House serving hot chocolate, coffee, and gelato.

name: Varsano's Chocolate
usp: Greenwich Village chocolatier handcrafting and hand-dipping homemade chocolates daily, including truffles, caramels, fruit centers, and nut patties with varieties like s'mores and chocolate-covered potato chips.

name: Daniel Corpuz Chocolatier
usp: Boutique chocolatier blending traditional Belgian chocolate techniques with Filipino-Asian flavors, offering handcrafted bonbons, cakes, cookies, pastries, and plated desserts with cultural influences like ube, calamansi, and pandan.

name: Stick With Me
usp: Artisanal chocolatier handcrafting luxury bonbons entirely by hand in small batches, with hand-shelled and hand-painted confections taking three days to create, recognized by Vogue and Oprah.

name: Confectionery
usp: Vegan bakery and artisanal chocolate shop creating handcrafted bonbons, macarons, and baked goods with fair-trade, organic ingredients; no nuts, soy, or gluten.

name: Neuhaus Soho
usp: Belgian chocolate retailer for over 160 years, inventor of the original Belgian praline, selling handcrafted bonbons, truffles, bars, tablets, and chocolate mousse, all made in Brussels atelier.

name: Mojo Desserts
usp: Country's first artisanal chocolate mousse bar, handcrafted in small batches with premium Belgian chocolate by Belgian Chef Johan Halsberghe, serving five signature mousse flavors.

name: Sweet Vegan Chocolates
usp: Handcrafted vegan and allergen-free chocolate truffles with smooth ganache enrobed in 70% dark chocolate, offering 18+ flavors made entirely in NYC with fair-trade ingredients and no nuts, soy, or gluten.

name: Chocolat Moderne
usp: Handcrafted gourmet chocolates using premium French Valrhona chocolate, featuring over 100 varieties of bonbons, bars, drinking chocolates, and caramel sauces with no preservatives or artificial flavorings.
